goal: Introduce the minimum cross-module original-submission provenance boundary required to close EVAL-POST-002 by making TrainingAttempt ordinary/public construction factory-only, preventing ordinary/public same-identity reconstruction, and adapting Evaluation to trust that construction boundary rather than caller-reconstructed values, while preserving all Training/Evaluation business semantics that do not depend on public TrainingAttempt reconstruction. Introduce no persistence, registry, hidden provenance field, secret token field, fingerprint, nonce, or generalized identity framework.

published_training.construction_fact: Published TrainingAttempt permits ordinary/public direct construction with caller-chosen internally valid id, created_at, stage, context, learned_concept_ids, and user_analysis; existing tests exercise constructor-valid direct reconstruction. Evaluation-only value validation cannot distinguish an original submission from a publicly reconstructed lookalike.

acceptance: Keep create_training_attempt(...) as the supported public creator of submitted TrainingAttempt records through the same FORMAL and FOCUSED creation path. Every legitimate factory call assigns a fresh UUID4 and a fresh UTC submission timestamp, image_reference=None, revision=None, and status=SUBMITTED; callers cannot choose an existing submission identity through the factory.

Make ordinary/public TrainingAttempt construction factory-only. Reject TrainingAttempt(...) with copied or chosen values, including internally valid values, before Evaluation can treat a reconstructed record as an original submission. Reject every ordinary/public route that can create another valid same-submission lookalike.

Reject dataclasses.replace, copy.copy, copy.deepcopy, pickle for every protocol 0 through pickle.HIGHEST_PROTOCOL, and exposed reduction/state-restoration routes for TrainingAttempt. Equivalent ordinary standard-library reconstruction routes must not preserve an existing submission identity while changing authority-bearing stage, context, knowledge_boundary, learned_concept_ids, target, objective, or observation task. Cover __setstate__, __reduce__, and __reduce_ex__ or their implementation-exposed equivalents without creating a serializer framework.

Keep factory-created TrainingAttempt frozen, with normal frozen-dataclass immutability for supported public use and exactly the existing fields id, created_at, stage, image_reference, user_analysis, user_confidence, revision, status, and context. Add no provenance field, token field, hidden persistent field, alternate TrainingAttempt type, or additional record field.

Preserve KnowledgeBoundary and TrainingContext canonicalization and caller-owned collection copying, immutable context/boundary, exact Learning Map reference, canonical cumulative S1/S2/S3 allowed concept counts 13/19/28, learned-subset rules, and target-concept rules.

Preserve user-first submission, the initial user_analysis, user confidence semantics, and all unrelated Training business behavior. Training must remain standard-library-only, with no Evaluation, scoring, LearningState, database, or persistence behavior. Replace direct-constructor tests that conflict with factory-only authority with factory-only provenance regressions; do not retain public direct construction merely to keep old tests green.

Evaluation must require the exact supported TrainingAttempt type and validate its business invariants and historical boundary. Rely on the factory-only construction contract for ordinary/public original-submission provenance; do not reconstruct a new TrainingAttempt from caller values as proof of provenance or infer provenance from id/created_at/user_analysis equality alone. Preserve submission-time learned knowledge exactly and retain public-type and spoofed-input defenses.

For an original factory-created S1 submission learned_concept_ids=[CON-S1-HIGH], OBS-002 must remain ineligible in both primary_error and contributors. Direct TrainingAttempt(...) reconstruction preserving id, created_at, and user_analysis while adding CON-S1-FACT-VS-INTERPRETATION must be rejected before Evaluation can consume it as the original submission; assert rejection and original-object preservation for both channels.
Reject same-identity S3 context transplantation before LOC-001 becomes eligible, covering both primary_error and contributors while preserving the original S1 submission unchanged.

Regressions must attack direct construction, dataclasses.replace(original_attempt, ...), copy.copy, copy.deepcopy, all supported pickle protocols, and every restoration/reduction route exposed by the implementation. Cover identity-preserving same-Stage later-learning expansion and future-Stage transplant through applicable reconstruction routes; the original object must remain unchanged after each attempt.

A fresh legitimate create_training_attempt(...) call must produce a new submission identity and continue to work. A genuinely historically eligible factory-created attempt must remain evaluable in both primary and contributor paths; protection must not reject legitimate eligibility or contaminate earlier submissions with later learning.

Preserve exactly the nine Evaluation fields attempt_id, what_was_correct, primary_issue, primary_error, contributors, hint, skill_signal, evaluation_confidence, and abstain. Add no Evaluation field, provenance-token argument, or alternate Evaluation type.

Preserve the independently verified EVAL-POST-001 closure and all Evaluation __setstate__/__reduce__/__reduce_ex__ hardening, pickle-protocol rejection/safety, copy/deepcopy/replace defenses, blocked direct construction, absence of __dict__ and mutable restoration aliases, and canonical immutable output.

Preserve all 19 Error mappings: OBS-001, OBS-002, OBS-004, STR-001, STR-002, STR-006, STR-007, STR-003, STR-004, STR-005, REA-002, REA-003, REA-005, LOC-001, LOC-002, LOC-003, LOC-004, LOC-005, and LOC-006. Preserve S1/S2/S3 Stage ceilings, CORE plus learned-at-submission eligibility, later-learning isolation, and target/objective/observation-task relevance.

Preserve at most one primary error, zero through two unique contributors, primary/contributor separation, Error-ID prose protection, strict bool abstain, LOW confidence implies abstain, abstain implies no formal errors, non-abstaining correct/no-error support, internally derived skill_signal, mutable diagnostic-input copying, process-not-outcome judgment, and no future-market dependency.

This MVP protects ordinary/public Python APIs and standard-library reconstruction routes, including the EVAL-POST-002 route. Deliberate unrestricted interpreter-level memory tampering, direct object memory manipulation, or use of explicitly private module internals are outside this public-API threat model. Do not turn this work into a generalized security sandbox; ordinary/public same-submission lookalikes must still be rejected.

Provenance must come from the supported construction boundary, not caller-supplied markers. Introduce no database, persistence layer, durable attempt registry, in-memory global provenance registry, hidden persistent field, capability/token field, caller-supplied signature, fingerprint, nonce, secret, cryptographic identity system, generalized provenance/identity/validator framework, shared helpers/common/utils, serializer framework, or alternate record type.

The exact six owned business paths are the complete implementation scope. Do not mutate docs/CONTRACTS.md, either module __init__.py, Learning Map, Learning State, Review, Study Entry, or any governance file during business implementation. The existing TrainingAttempt field contract remains unchanged; only supported construction semantics change. If docs/CONTRACTS.md must change, HARD_STOP and return SCOPE_REPROPOSAL_REQUIRED.

Do not introduce S4-S8, scoring/ranking/rewards, screenshot/TradingView functionality, market data, predictions/signals, API/UI/plugin code, or any other unowned path. Preserve standard-library-only and no-persistence constraints across both modules.

Future business execution requires explicit user Work Unit approval, separate governed authorization/execution instruction, and a fresh independent PRE_EXECUTION PASS before any business mutation. PRE must confirm the concrete factory-only mechanism is sufficient without registry/token/persistence, the six-path scope is enough, shared contracts need no modification, Training public factory behavior remains compatible, Evaluation can consume hardened attempts without value-based provenance reconstruction, EVAL-POST-001 closure is preserved, and the regression plan is complete. No PRE PASS means no mutation.

Execute any future approved implementation only on the existing Evaluation candidate with initial HEAD, complete tree, and core/test/Training blobs exactly as bound in future_execution. Stop and revalidate authority on any mismatch; this proposal task must not mutate that candidate or start FIX round 2.

Future FIX completion requires a complete independent CROSS-MODULE hostile POST covering both Training and Evaluation because published Training construction behavior changes. It must independently attack direct TrainingAttempt construction, replace, copy/deepcopy, every pickle protocol, state restoration/reduction, same-ID reconstruction, same-Stage later-learning expansion, and future-Stage transplant, then rerun the full existing Evaluation hostile matrix. POST must not be limited to EVAL-POST-002; passing tests alone does not establish publication readiness.

Before future implementation completion, pass the Training regression suite, Evaluation regression suite, and full project test suite after replacing only constructor tests incompatible with the new approved factory-only contract. Preserve unrelated Training and Evaluation semantics and the prior hostile-review protections.

This artifact is a scope-escalation proposal only, not implementation, PRE approval, user approval, or Work Unit authorization. Keep EVAL-POST-002 OPEN, preserve EVAL-POST-001 CLOSED, keep Evaluation NOT COMPLETE / NOT PUBLISHED, and do not start Learning State.
